recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍紅血球大很多的巨大原紅血球（giant proerythroblast）：核圓大、染色質細緻偏紅紫、隱約可見核內顆粒，細胞質是一圈深藍色並帶小空泡與泡狀突起；在紅系再生不良（pure red cell aplasia）背景下，應想到 parvovirus B19 感染。
features: Single giant erythroid precursor several times the diameter of surrounding red cells
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin, reddish-purple tint and small pinkish nuclear granules/nucleoli
Narrow rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a row of small clear vacuoles
Blunt cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections at the cell edge
Background of red cells with rouleaux-like overlap; no other erythroid precursors in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single giant proerythroblast, markedly larger than surrounding red cells. It has a large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and small pinkish nuclear granules, a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing small vacuoles, and blunt cytoplasmic blebs. No maturing erythroid precursors are present in the field. In the setting of acquired pure red cell aplasia, giant proerythroblasts suggest parvovirus B19 infection, which should be confirmed by PCR or immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast in pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less intensely basophilic cytoplasm without the dark blue rim and blebs, and are MPO- or CD34-positive rather than E-cadherin/glycophorin-positive.
Megaloblastic change affects the whole erythroid series with abundant maturing megaloblasts and hypersegmented neutrophils, not isolated giant proerythroblasts in an erythroid-depleted marrow.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (≥30%) rather than rare scattered giant forms with erythroid hypoplasia.
Plasmablasts have an eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear hof and CD138 positivity, lacking the uniform deep-blue rim and dog-ear blebs.
